gaps.title: Protocol access exposed to all authenticated users via DocumentController
gaps.jtbd: When a user logs in, I want access to protocols to be restricted only to Researcher, Epidemiologist, or Admin roles, so that unauthorized personnel cannot view sensitive protocols.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user without the RESEARCHER, EPIDEMIOLOGIST, or ADMIN role, When they attempt to access documents via /api/v1/documents, Then they should not be able to retrieve documents of type PROTOCOL.
gaps.reason: The brief requires 'Исследователь / Аспирант с правом доступа к протоколам'. While ProtocolController is secured by roles, DocumentController exposes all documents to any authenticated user, failing to restrict protocol access.

gaps.title: Missing LTI Form Launch Web Response
gaps.jtbd: When an LMS initiates an LTI launch, I want the system to respond with an HTML view or redirect, so that the tool renders correctly within the LMS iframe.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid LTI launch request from Moodle, When the tool processes the launch, Then it responds with a 302 redirect or an HTML view instead of raw JSON.
gaps.reason: Domain-standard expectation: The brief specifies LTI integration. LTI launches are form POSTs from a browser iframe expecting an HTML document or redirect, but the implementation responds with a JSON payload containing tokens, which breaks standard LTI consumer flows.
